aboutPage.title: About Us 🌸
aboutPage.subtitle: Get to know Piko & Lea closer
aboutPage.whoAreWeDesc: We are two students from Binus University Bandung who have a huge passion for arts and crafts. Starting from our hobby of drawing and making accessories, we decided to build 'Piko & Lea' as a platform for our creativity.
aboutPage.pikoDesc: Piko is the magic hand behind every face stroke on your keychain. Specialist in sketching and coloring.
aboutPage.leaDesc: Lea ensures every drawing is safe inside the casing, assembles the charms, and packs your order beautifully.
aboutPage.locationDesc: We are based around Binus University Bandung Campus. For the campus area, we provide COD (Cash on Delivery) service!
aboutPage.instagram: Follow our daily life and latest works on Instagram
